नुद्^1 {c6c} U. (नुदति-ते, नुत्त or नुन्न,
प्रणुदते)
1 To push, push or drive on,
impel, propel; मंदं मंदं नुदति
पवनश्चानुकूलो यथा त्वां

.
--3 To remove, drive
away, cast away, dispel; अदस्त्वया
नुन्नमनुत्तमं तमः Śi. 1. 27;
केयूरबंधोच्छ्वसितैर्नुनोद

.; 5. 28.
--4 To throw, cast,
send.
--5 Ved. To raise, lift up.
--

To remove, drive away.
--2 To prompt, incite, push on or
urge forward. WITH उप to drive
away, remove; Śi. 4. 61.
--प्र to
dispel, drive off, remove; Śi. 9. 71.
[1] Correction submitted by on 20170131. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/335. note: verb missing virama.

नुद a. (At the end of comp.)
Pushing, impelling, driving away.
